title: Standalone complete reads for mandatory skills and references
failure_signature: A combined mandatory-skill and discovery read timed out before returning a complete receipt.
candidate_workaround: Read every mandatory skill and directly required reference completely in its own bounded command before task actions, then run discovery separately.
recurrence_guard: Never infer a complete instruction read from a timed-out batch; preserve the timeout and obtain one end-to-end witness per mandatory file.
rollback: Discard only the incomplete batch result, retain its negative, and reread each authoritative instruction source directly.
scope_boundary: Instruction-read reliability only; not authority, identity continuity, or validation evidence.
